```{r}
# Define directories
project_dir <- dirname(normalizePath(knitr::current_input(dir = TRUE)))
counts_dir <- file.path(project_dir, "inputs")
metadata_dir <- file.path(project_dir, "inputs")
blast_dir <- file.path(project_dir, "inputs")
objects_dir <- file.path(project_dir, "objects")
results_dir <- file.path(project_dir, "results")

# make sure directories exist
dir.create(results_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(objects_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# Set working directory
setwd(project_dir)
```

```{r}
# Load and clean counts data
counts <- read.table(paste0(counts_dir, "/gene_count_matrix.txt"), header = TRUE, row.names = 1)
anyDuplicated(colnames(counts)) # 0
print(head(capture.output(str(counts)))) #85714 obs./genes # usually ~25,000 genes this is a lot
```

```{r}
# Filter lowly expressed genes (5 count) in at least 50% of the libraries, strict threshold
filtered_counts <- counts
num_libraries <- ncol(filtered_counts)
threshold_libraries <- ceiling(0.5 * num_libraries)
expressed_in_enough_libraries <- rowSums(filtered_counts >= 5) >= threshold_libraries
filtered_counts <- filtered_counts[expressed_in_enough_libraries, ]
print(head(capture.output(str(filtered_counts)))) # 51043 obs./genes # still double what's expected
```

```{r}
# Load metadata
metadata <- read.csv(paste0(metadata_dir,"/metadata_LB.csv"))
metadata <- metadata %>% dplyr::select(-`Description.of.Experimental.Design..`)
summary(metadata)
```

```{r}
# Parse description column and convert to factors
metadata$variety <- factor(metadata$Variety)
metadata$time <- factor(metadata$Time)
metadata$treatment <- factor(metadata$Treatment)

# Remove samples from metadata that are missing from counts data
metadata <- metadata %>%
  filter(!SampleName %in% c("FEM_24h_I3", "FEM_72h_I1"))

# Reorder metadata to match counts
metadata <- metadata[match(colnames(counts), metadata$SampleName), ]
all(metadata$SampleName == colnames(counts)) # should return true if all are matching
```

```{r}
# create contingency tables to observe experiment structure
table(metadata$variety, metadata$time, metadata$treatment)
  # only 2 samples for FEM-24h and FEM-72h
  # control samples only at 24h

# Convert time to numeric
metadata$time_numeric <- as.numeric(metadata$time)

# Scale time
metadata$time_numeric_scaled <- scale(metadata$time_numeric, center = TRUE, scale = TRUE)

# Set reference levels for interaction term
metadata$variety <- relevel(metadata$variety, ref = "201")
metadata$time <- relevel(metadata$time, ref = "24")
metadata$treatment <- relevel(metadata$treatment, ref = "control")

```

```{r}
# load blastp results
blastp_results <- read.delim(gzfile(file.path(blast_dir,"Perrie_v1.0_blast_results.tsv.gz")),header = FALSE,stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
colnames(blastp_results) <- c("query", "subject", "pident", "length", "mismatch", "gapopen",
                              "qstart", "qend", "sstart", "send", "evalue", "bitscore", "description")
head(blastp_results)
blastp_results$gene <- sub("\\.[0-9]+$", "", blastp_results$query) # change to format gene 

# Extract UniProt IDs for all genes 
blastp_results$uniprot_id <- sub("sp\\|([^|]+)\\|.*", "\\1", blastp_results$subject)

# Filter for top hit per gene
blast_top <- blastp_results %>%
  group_by(gene) %>%
  slice_min(order_by = evalue, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup()

```

```{r}
# Gene enrichment prep

# Download GOA uniprot gene association file to map uniprot protein accessions to gene ontology terms
options(timeout = 600)
url <- "https://ftp.ebi.ac.uk/pub/databases/GO/goa/ARABIDOPSIS/goa_arabidopsis.gaf.gz"
con <- gzcon(url(url, "rb"))  # 'rb' = read binary to read directly from gzipped connection
goa_lines <- readLines(con)
close(con)

# Remove comments and split tab-delimited lines
goa_data <- goa_lines[!startsWith(goa_lines, "!")]
goa <- read.delim(textConnection(goa_data), header = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
colnames(goa)[1:7] <- c("DB", "UniProt_ID", "DB_Object_Symbol", "Qualifier", "GO_ID", "DB_Reference", "Evidence_Code")
```


## Model everything (Wald)

```{r}
# Full model design ~ variety * treatment * time will run into rank-deficiency because no controls at 28 or 72 h
# Need to break into groups
metadata$group <- factor(with(metadata, paste(Variety, Treatment, Time, sep = "_")))

# i.e. the genes should behave in response to cps as they do to che
dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = filtered_counts,
                              colData = metadata,
                              design = ~ group)

# Filter lowly expressed genes where 2 samples have > 10 counts (because at least 2 replicates)
keep <- rowSums(counts(dds) >= 10) >= 2
dds <- dds[keep,]
model <- DESeq(dds)

# If the above fails to converge, remove genes that will not work in binomial model
while (any(mcols(model)$betaConv == FALSE)) {
  keep_converge <- mcols(model)$betaConv
  dds <- dds[keep_converge,]
  model <- DESeq(dds)
}

# save dds result
saveRDS(dds, file = paste0(objects_dir, "/all_wald_dds.RData"))
saveRDS(model, file = paste0(objects_dir, "/all_wald_model.RData"))

```

```{r}
# Summarize model results
dds <- readRDS(file=paste0(objects_dir, "/all_wald_dds.RData"))
model <- readRDS(file=paste0(objects_dir, "/all_wald_model.RData"))
print(resultsNames(model))
print(summary(results(model)))
```

```{r}
# Plot dispersion
dds <- readRDS(file=paste0(objects_dir, "/all_wald_dds.RData"))
model <- readRDS(file=paste0(objects_dir, "/all_wald_model.RData"))
plotDispEsts(model)
attr(dispersionFunction(model), "coefficients")

```


### Extract DEGs

```{r}
# Extract interaction terms for simple contrasts
dds <- readRDS(file=paste0(objects_dir, "/all_wald_dds.RData"))
model <- readRDS(file=paste0(objects_dir, "/all_wald_model.RData"))

# Define contrasts
comparisons <- list(
  FEMinoc24_vs_FEMctrl24 = c("FEM_inoculated_24", "FEM_control_24"), # FEM inoculated v. FEM control
  FEMinoc48_vs_FEMctrl24 = c("FEM_inoculated_48", "FEM_control_24"),
  FEMinoc72_vs_FEMctrl24 = c("FEM_inoculated_72", "FEM_control_24"),
  
  `201inoc24_vs_201ctrl24` = c("201_inoculated_24", "201_control_24"), # 201 inoculated v. 201 control
  `201inoc48_vs_201ctrl24` = c("201_inoculated_48", "201_control_24"),
  `201inoc72_vs_201ctrl24` = c("201_inoculated_72", "201_control_24"),
  
  FEMinoc24_vs_201inoc24 = c("FEM_inoculated_24", "201_inoculated_24"), # FEM inoculated v. 201 inoculated
  FEMinoc48_vs_201inoc48 = c("FEM_inoculated_48", "201_inoculated_48"),
  FEMinoc72_vs_201inoc72 = c("FEM_inoculated_72", "201_inoculated_72")
)

# Store results
res_list <- list()
sig_list <- list()

for (name in names(comparisons)) {
  groups <- comparisons[[name]]
  
  # 1) Extract results for this contrast
  res_all <- results(model, contrast = c("group", groups[1], groups[2]))
  
  # 2) Significant DEGs (padj < 0.05)
  sig_all <- res_all[!is.na(res_all$padj) & res_all$padj < 0.05, ]
  
  # Store in lists
  res_list[[name]] <- res_all
  sig_list[[name]] <- sig_all
  
  # 3) Summary to console (customized per contrast name)
  cat("\n==== Contrast:", name, "====\n")
  cat("Total DEGs (padj < 0.05): ", nrow(sig_all), "\n", sep = "")
  cat("Up (LFC > 1): ", sum(sig_all$log2FoldChange >  1, na.rm = TRUE), "\n", sep = "")
  cat("Down (LFC < -1): ", sum(sig_all$log2FoldChange < -1, na.rm = TRUE), "\n", sep = "")
  
  # 4) Write CSV of significant DEGs
  write.csv(
    as.data.frame(sig_all),
    file = file.path(results_dir, paste0("all_wald_DEGs_", name, ".csv")),
    row.names = TRUE
  )
  
  # 5) Save R objects
  saveRDS(res_all, file = file.path(objects_dir, paste0("all_wald_res_", name, ".rds")))
  saveRDS(sig_all, file = file.path(objects_dir, paste0("all_wald_DEGs_", name, ".rds")))
}

```

```{r}
# Extract interaction terms for paired contrasts
dds <- readRDS(file=paste0(objects_dir, "/all_wald_dds.RData"))
model <- readRDS(file=paste0(objects_dir, "/all_wald_model.RData"))

# Define contrasts
intersection_pairs <- list(
  FEM_24 = c("FEMinoc24_vs_FEMctrl24", "FEMinoc24_vs_201inoc24"),
  FEM_48 = c("FEMinoc48_vs_FEMctrl24", "FEMinoc48_vs_201inoc48"),
  FEM_72 = c("FEMinoc72_vs_FEMctrl24", "FEMinoc72_vs_201inoc72")
)

for (nm in names(intersection_pairs)) {
  compA <- intersection_pairs[[nm]][1]  # FEM vs FEM control
  compB <- intersection_pairs[[nm]][2]  # FEM vs 201
 
  # Genes significant in each comparison
  genesA <- rownames(sig_list[[compA]])
  genesB <- rownames(sig_list[[compB]])
  
  common_genes <- intersect(genesA, genesB)
  
  if (length(common_genes) == 0) {
    cat("\nNo overlapping DEGs for", nm, "\n")
    next
  }
  
  # Build a small summary data.frame for the intersection
  df <- data.frame(
    gene        = common_genes,
    log2FC_FEM_vs_ctrl = sig_list[[compA]][common_genes, "log2FoldChange"],
    padj_FEM_vs_ctrl   = sig_list[[compA]][common_genes, "padj"],
    log2FC_FEM_vs_201  = sig_list[[compB]][common_genes, "log2FoldChange"],
    padj_FEM_vs_201    = sig_list[[compB]][common_genes, "padj"],
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  
  # Optional: classify direction of regulation for FEM
  df$direction <- NA_character_
  
  # Here, positive log2FC means "higher in FEM" because FEM is the first level 
  # in each contrast c("group", FEM_inoculated_X, comparator)
  df$direction[df$log2FC_FEM_vs_ctrl > 0 & df$log2FC_FEM_vs_201 > 0] <- "FEM_up_vs_both"
  df$direction[df$log2FC_FEM_vs_ctrl < 0 & df$log2FC_FEM_vs_201 < 0] <- "FEM_down_vs_both"
  df$direction[df$log2FC_FEM_vs_ctrl > 0 & df$log2FC_FEM_vs_201 < 0] <- "FEM_up_vs_ctrl_down_vs_201"
  df$direction[df$log2FC_FEM_vs_ctrl < 0 & df$log2FC_FEM_vs_201 > 0] <- "FEM_down_vs_ctrl_up_vs_201"
  
  # Store in list
  intersection_pairs[[nm]] <- df
  
  # Write CSV
  write.csv(
    df,
    file = file.path(results_dir, paste0("all_wald_DEGs_intersection_", nm, ".csv")),
    row.names = FALSE
  )
  
  cat("\n==== Intersection:", nm, "====\n")
  cat("Overlapping DEGs: ", nrow(df), "\n", sep = "")
  cat("FEM_up_vs_both:   ", sum(df$direction == "FEM_up_vs_both", na.rm = TRUE), "\n", sep = "")
  cat("FEM_down_vs_both: ", sum(df$direction == "FEM_down_vs_both", na.rm = TRUE), "\n", sep = "")
}
```

### PCA

```{r}
# PCA 3x1
dds <- readRDS(file=paste0(objects_dir, "/all_wald_dds.RData"))
model <- readRDS(file=paste0(objects_dir, "/all_wald_model.RData"))
log2fc_thresholds <- c(0, 1, 2)
vsd <- vst(model, blind =FALSE)
expr_mat <- assay(vsd)
pca_res <- prcomp(t(expr_mat), scale. = TRUE)
variance_explained <- pca_res$sdev^2 / sum(pca_res$sdev^2) * 100
pc1_var <- round(variance_explained[1], 1)
pc2_var <- round(variance_explained[2], 1)
pc3_var <- round(variance_explained[3], 1)
pc4_var <- round(variance_explained[4], 1)

# Create PCA dataframe and include variables for coloring
pca_df <- data.frame(PC1 = pca_res$x[, 1], 
                     PC2 = pca_res$x[, 2],
                     PC3 = pca_res$x[, 3],
                     PC4 = pca_res$x[, 4],
                     variety = colData(vsd)$Variety,
                     time = colData(vsd)$Time,
                     treatment = colData(vsd)$Treatment
                     )

# Plot
base_theme <- theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13),
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13),
    axis.text = element_text(color = "black", size = 11),
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 11),
    legend.key = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.4),
    plot.margin = margin(6, 8, 6, 6)
  )

make_pca_plot <- function(df, color_var, colors, title,
                          show_x = FALSE, show_y = FALSE) {
  
  x_lab <- if (show_x) paste0("PC1 (", pc1_var, "%)") else NULL
  y_lab <- if (show_y) paste0("PC2 (", pc2_var, "%)") else NULL
  
  ggplot(df, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = {{ color_var }})) +
    geom_point(size = 2.8, alpha = 0.9, stroke = 0.4) +
    scale_color_manual(values = colors) +
    labs(
      title = title,
      x = x_lab,
      y = y_lab
    ) +
    base_theme +
    theme(
      axis.title.x = if (!show_x) element_blank() else element_text(),
      axis.title.y = if (!show_y) element_blank() else element_text()
    )
}

# Colors (unchanged)
variety_colors <- c("201" = "#984EA3", "FEM" = "#1B9E77")
time_colors <- c("24" = "#FDBF6F", "48" = "#FF7F00", "72" = "#B15928")
treatment_colors <- c("control" = "#4D4D4D", "inoculated" = "#377EB8")

## Plots in Figure 3 order
p_time <- make_pca_plot(
  pca_df, as.factor(time), time_colors,
  "Hours post inoculation (hpi)",
  show_x = FALSE, show_y = FALSE
)

p_treatment <- make_pca_plot(
  pca_df, treatment, treatment_colors,
  "Treatment",
  show_x = FALSE, show_y = TRUE
)

p_variety <- make_pca_plot(
  pca_df, variety, variety_colors,
  "Variety",
  show_x = TRUE, show_y = FALSE
)

# Combine in A-B-C order
p_panel <- p_time / p_treatment / p_variety +
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = "A")

p_panel

# Save
ggsave(
  paste0(results_dir, "/all_wald_PCA_3x1_panel.png"),
  plot = p_panel,
  width = 6.5,
  height = 10,
  dpi = 600,
  bg = "white"
)

```

## Model inoculated (Wald)

The restriction of control libraries to one time point in the full model resulted in incomplete treatment × time contrasts. Thus this model retains only the inoculated samples.

```{r}
# Subset metadata and counts
meta_inoc <- metadata[metadata$Treatment == "inoculated", ]
counts_inoc <- filtered_counts[, colnames(filtered_counts) %in% meta_inoc$SampleName]
meta_inoc <- meta_inoc[match(colnames(counts_inoc), meta_inoc$SampleName), ]
all(meta_inoc$SampleName == colnames(counts_inoc))  

```

```{r}
# Inoculated samples only model
dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
  countData = counts_inoc,
  colData   = meta_inoc,
  design    = ~ variety + time + variety:time
)

# Filter lowly expressed genes where 2 samples have > 10 counts
keep <- rowSums(counts(dds) >= 10) >= 2
dds <- dds[keep,]
model <- DESeq(dds)

# save dds result
saveRDS(dds, file = paste0(objects_dir, "/inoculated_wald_dds.RData"))
saveRDS(model, file = paste0(objects_dir, "/inoculated_wald_model.RData"))

```


```{r}
# Summarize model results
dds <- readRDS(file=paste0(objects_dir, "/inoculated_wald_dds.RData"))
model <- readRDS(file=paste0(objects_dir, "/inoculated_wald_model.RData"))
print(resultsNames(model))
print(summary(results(model)))
```


```{r}
# Plot dispersion
dds <- readRDS(file=paste0(objects_dir, "/inoculated_wald_dds.RData"))
model <- readRDS(file=paste0(objects_dir, "/inoculated_wald_model.RData"))
plotDispEsts(model)
attr(dispersionFunction(model), "coefficients")

```


### Extract DEGs

```{r}
# Extract interaction term
dds <- readRDS(file=paste0(objects_dir, "/inoculated_wald_dds.RData"))
model <- readRDS(file=paste0(objects_dir, "/inoculated_wald_model.RData"))

# Define comparisons
comparisons <- list(
  FEMvs201_24 = list(type  = "name", value = "variety_FEM_vs_201"),
  FEMvs201_48 = list(type  = "contrast", value = list(c("variety_FEM_vs_201", "varietyFEM.time48"))),
  FEMvs201_72 = list(type  = "contrast", value = list(c("variety_FEM_vs_201", "varietyFEM.time72")))
)

# Store as list
res_list <- list()
sig_list <- list()

# Loop over comparisons
for (nm in names(comparisons)) {
  cmp <- comparisons[[nm]]
  
  # --- Call DESeq2 results() for this contrast ---
  if (cmp$type == "name") {
    res_all <- results(model, name = cmp$value)
  } else if (cmp$type == "contrast") {
    res_all <- results(model, contrast = cmp$value)
  } else {
    stop("Unknown comparison type for: ", nm)
  }
  
  # --- Significant DEGs ---
  sig_all <- res_all[!is.na(res_all$padj) & res_all$padj < 0.05, ]
  
  # --- Store in lists ---
  res_list[[nm]] <- res_all
  sig_list[[nm]] <- sig_all
  
  # --- Console summary ---
  cat("\n==== Contrast:", nm, "====\n")
  cat("Total DEGs (padj < 0.05): ", nrow(sig_all), "\n", sep = "")
  cat("Up (LFC > 1): ",  sum(sig_all$log2FoldChange >  1, na.rm = TRUE), "\n", sep = "")
  cat("Down (LFC < -1): ", sum(sig_all$log2FoldChange < -1, na.rm = TRUE), "\n", sep = "")
  
  # --- Write CSV of significant DEGs ---
  write.csv(
    as.data.frame(sig_all),
    file = file.path(results_dir, paste0("inoculated_wald_DEGs_", nm, ".csv")),
    row.names = TRUE
  )
  
  # --- Save R objects ---
  saveRDS(res_all, file = file.path(objects_dir, paste0("inoculated_wald_res_", nm, ".rds")))
  saveRDS(sig_all, file = file.path(objects_dir, paste0("inoculated_wald_DEGs_", nm, ".rds")))
}
```

### Volcano plots

```{r}
# Plot volcano plots as panel

# Define contrasts
comparisons <- list(
  FEMvs201_24 = list(type  = "name", value = "variety_FEM_vs_201"),
  FEMvs201_48 = list(type  = "contrast", value = list(c("variety_FEM_vs_201", "varietyFEM.time48"))),
  FEMvs201_72 = list(type  = "contrast", value = list(c("variety_FEM_vs_201", "varietyFEM.time72")))
)

layout_vec <- c("FEMvs201_24", "FEMvs201_48", "FEMvs201_72")

pretty_titles <- c(
  FEMvs201_24 = "24 hpi",
  FEMvs201_48 = "48 hpi",
  FEMvs201_72 = "72 hpi"
)

volcano_colors <- c(
  "Upregulated genes"   = "#F4A7B9",
  "Downregulated genes" = "#A7D3F4",
  "Not Significant"     = "#D8D8D8"
)

plot_list <- vector("list", length(layout_vec))
names(plot_list) <- layout_vec

for (comp in layout_vec) {
  
  message("Processing: ", comp)
  
  res_file <- file.path(objects_dir, paste0("inoculated_wald_res_", comp, ".rds"))
  res_treatment <- readRDS(res_file)
  
  res_df <- as.data.frame(res_treatment)
  res_df <- res_df[!is.na(res_df$padj) & is.finite(res_df$log2FoldChange), ]
  
  res_df$significance <- "Not Significant"
  res_df$significance[res_df$padj < 0.05 & res_df$log2FoldChange > 0] <- "Upregulated genes"
  res_df$significance[res_df$padj < 0.05 & res_df$log2FoldChange < 0] <- "Downregulated genes"
  
  res_df$significance <- factor(
    res_df$significance,
    levels = c("Upregulated genes", "Downregulated genes", "Not Significant")
  )
  
  c <- match(comp, layout_vec)
  
  x_lab <- if (c == 2) "log2 fold change" else NULL
  y_lab <- if (c == 1) expression(-log[10]("adjusted p-value")) else NULL
  
  p <- ggplot(res_df, aes(x = log2FoldChange, y = -log10(padj), color = significance)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linewidth = 0.35, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey45") +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.35, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey45") +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.75, size = 1.8, stroke = 0) +
    scale_color_manual(values = volcano_colors, drop = FALSE) +
    labs(
      title = pretty_titles[comp],
      x = x_lab,
      y = y_lab
    ) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12, hjust = 0.5),
      axis.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11),
      axis.text = element_text(color = "black", size = 10),
      axis.line = element_line(linewidth = 0.45),
      axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = 0.45),
      panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.45),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.title = element_blank(),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
      legend.key = element_blank(),
      plot.margin = margin(6, 6, 6, 6)
    )
  
  plot_list[[comp]] <- p
}

panel <- (plot_list[[layout_vec[1]]] |
          plot_list[[layout_vec[2]]] |
          plot_list[[layout_vec[3]]]) +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect") &
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA)
  )
panel

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(results_dir, "inoculated_wald_volcano_1x3_panel.png"),
  plot = panel,
  width = 11,
  height = 4,
  dpi = 600,
  bg = "white"
)
```

### Blast
```{r}
# contrasts to loop
labels <- c("FEMvs201_24", "FEMvs201_48", "FEMvs201_72")

# set blastp filter parameters
max_evalue        <- 1e-10
min_pident        <- 40
min_align_len_abs <- 100
min_qcov          <- 0.50
min_scov          <- 0.50

# add blast ouput to DEGs
for (label in labels) {

  message("Processing: ", label)

  # Load data
  res_obj <- readRDS(file.path(objects_dir, paste0("inoculated_wald_res_",  label, ".rds")))
  deg_obj <- readRDS(file.path(objects_dir, paste0("inoculated_wald_DEGs_", label, ".rds")))

  # Convert DESeqResults to tibble
  deg_tbl <- deg_obj %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    rownames_to_column(var = "gene")

  # Annotate with blastp
  deg_annotated <- deg_tbl %>%
    left_join(blast_top, by = "gene") %>%
    mutate(
      evalue_num = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(evalue)),
      aln_len    = dplyr::coalesce(length, (qend - qstart + 1L)),
      qcov = if (all(c("qstart","qend","qlen") %in% names(cur_data_all()))) {
        (qend - qstart + 1) / qlen
      } else if (all(c("qstart","qend","query_len") %in% names(cur_data_all()))) {
        (qend - qstart + 1) / query_len
      } else NA_real_,
      scov = if (all(c("sstart","send","slen") %in% names(cur_data_all()))) {
        (abs(send - sstart) + 1) / slen
      } else if (all(c("sstart","send","subject_len") %in% names(cur_data_all()))) {
        (abs(send - sstart) + 1) / subject_len
      } else NA_real_
    )

  # Export all annotated
  write.csv(
    deg_annotated,
    file = file.path(results_dir, paste0("inoculated_wald_DEGs_", label, "_annotated.csv")),
    row.names = FALSE
  )

  # Upregulated
  deg_lfc1_up <- deg_annotated %>% filter(log2FoldChange > 1)
  write.csv(
    deg_lfc1_up,
    file = file.path(results_dir, paste0("inoculated_wald_DEGs_", label, "_annotated_L2FC1_up.csv")),
    row.names = FALSE
  )

  strong_blast_up <- deg_lfc1_up %>%
    filter(
      !is.na(pident), !is.na(evalue_num), !is.na(aln_len),
      evalue_num <= max_evalue,
      pident     >= min_pident,
      if (!all(is.na(qcov))) qcov >= min_qcov else TRUE,
      if (!all(is.na(scov))) scov >= min_scov else TRUE,
      if (all(is.na(qcov)) && all(is.na(scov))) aln_len >= min_align_len_abs else TRUE
    )
  write.csv(
    strong_blast_up,
    file = file.path(results_dir, paste0("inoculated_wald_DEGs_", label, "_annotated_L2FC1_up_strong_blast.csv")),
    row.names = FALSE
  )

  # Downregulated
  deg_lfc1_down <- deg_annotated %>% filter(log2FoldChange < -1)
  write.csv(
    deg_lfc1_down,
    file = file.path(results_dir, paste0("inoculated_wald_DEGs_", label, "_annotated_L2FC1_down.csv")),
    row.names = FALSE
  )

  strong_blast_down <- deg_lfc1_down %>%
    filter(
      !is.na(pident), !is.na(evalue_num), !is.na(aln_len),
      evalue_num <= max_evalue,
      pident     >= min_pident,
      if (!all(is.na(qcov))) qcov >= min_qcov else TRUE,
      if (!all(is.na(scov))) scov >= min_scov else TRUE,
      if (all(is.na(qcov)) && all(is.na(scov))) aln_len >= min_align_len_abs else TRUE
    )
  write.csv(
    strong_blast_down,
    file = file.path(results_dir, paste0("inoculated_wald_DEGs_", label, "_annotated_L2FC1_down_strong_blast.csv")),
    row.names = FALSE
  )

  message("Finished: ", label)
}


```

### GO

```{r}
# Plot GO plots as panel (3x1)

layout_mat <- matrix(c("FEMvs201_24",
                       "FEMvs201_48",
                       "FEMvs201_72"),
                     nrow = 3, byrow = TRUE)
labels <- as.vector(layout_mat)

go_plot_list <- vector("list", length = length(labels))
names(go_plot_list) <- labels

make_blank <- function(title_txt, msg = "Too few annotated DEGs\nwith GO terms") {
  ggplot() +
    annotate("text", x = 0, y = 0, label = msg) +
    labs(title = title_txt) +
    theme_void() +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 12, hjust = 0.5))
}

ont_list <- c("BP", "MF", "CC")

for (label in labels) {
  message("Processing ", label, " ...")

  # -----------------------------
  # Build background universe
  # -----------------------------

  res_obj <- readRDS(file.path(objects_dir, paste0("inoculated_wald_res_", label, ".rds")))

  tested_genes <- res_obj %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    tibble::rownames_to_column("gene") %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(pvalue)) %>%
    dplyr::pull(gene)

  tested_annotated <- tibble::tibble(gene = tested_genes) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(blast_top, by = "gene") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      uniprot_id = sub("sp\\|([^|]+)\\|.*", "\\1", subject)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      !is.na(subject),
      subject != "",
      !is.na(uniprot_id),
      uniprot_id != ""
    )

  gene_universe <- unique(tested_annotated$uniprot_id)

  gene2go_full <- goa %>%
    dplyr::filter(UniProt_ID %in% gene_universe) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(UniProt_ID) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(go_terms = list(unique(GO_ID)), .groups = "drop") %>%
    tibble::deframe()

  gene_universe <- intersect(gene_universe, names(gene2go_full))

  # -----------------------------
  # Load foreground DEGs
  # -----------------------------

  deg_annotated <- read.csv(
    file.path(results_dir, paste0("inoculated_wald_DEGs_", label, "_annotated.csv")),
    header = TRUE,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

  deg_annotated <- deg_annotated %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      uniprot_id = sub("sp\\|([^|]+)\\|.*", "\\1", subject)
    )

  deg_uniprot <- unique(na.omit(deg_annotated$uniprot_id))
  deg_uniprot <- intersect(deg_uniprot, gene_universe)

  deg_goa <- goa %>%
    dplyr::filter(UniProt_ID %in% deg_uniprot)

  if (nrow(deg_goa) < 10) {
    go_plot_list[[label]] <- make_blank(label)
    next
  }

  # -----------------------------
  # Build topGO gene list
  # -----------------------------

  geneList <- factor(as.integer(gene_universe %in% deg_uniprot))
  names(geneList) <- gene_universe
  geneList <- factor(geneList, levels = c(0, 1))

  # -----------------------------
  # Run topGO
  # -----------------------------

  res_all <- list()

  for (ont in ont_list) {
    go_data <- new(
      "topGOdata",
      ontology = ont,
      allGenes = geneList,
      annot    = annFUN.gene2GO,
      gene2GO  = gene2go_full
    )

    result <- suppressMessages(capture.output(
      res <- runTest(go_data, algorithm = "weight01", statistic = "fisher"),
      file = NULL
    ))
    result <- res

    res_table <- GenTable(
      go_data,
      weight01  = result,
      ranksOf   = "weight01",
      useLevels = TRUE
    )

    res_table$Ontology <- ont
    res_all[[ont]] <- res_table
  }

  all_results <- dplyr::bind_rows(res_all)
  all_results$weight01 <- as.numeric(all_results$weight01)

  sig_results <- all_results %>%
    dplyr::filter(weight01 < 0.05) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(Ontology) %>%
    dplyr::slice_min(order_by = weight01, n = 8, with_ties = FALSE) %>% # show up to 8 terms per ontology (24 max)
    dplyr::ungroup()

  if (nrow(sig_results) == 0) {
    go_plot_list[[label]] <- make_blank(label, "No significant GO terms")
    next
  }

  idx <- which(layout_mat == label, arr.ind = TRUE)
  r <- idx[1]

  # -----------------------------
  # Plot
  # -----------------------------

  p <- ggplot(sig_results, aes(
    x     = Significant,
    y     = reorder(Term, -Significant),
    color = Ontology,
    size  = -log10(weight01)
  )) +
    geom_point() +
    scale_color_manual(values = c(BP = "#A6CEE3", MF = "#FDBF6F", CC = "#B2DF8A")) +
    guides(size = "none") +
    labs(
      title = label,
      x = if (r == 3) "Number of Genes" else NULL,
      y = "GO Term"
    ) +
    cowplot::theme_cowplot(font_size = 8) +
    theme(
      axis.text.x  = element_text(size = 8),
      axis.text.y  = element_text(size = 8),
      axis.title.x = element_text(size = 8),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 8),
      plot.title   = element_text(size = 9, hjust = 0.5),
      legend.position = "none",
      plot.margin = margin(4, 4, 4, 4)
    )

  go_plot_list[[label]] <- p
}

go_panel <-
  go_plot_list[[layout_mat[1,1]]] /
  go_plot_list[[layout_mat[2,1]]] /
  go_plot_list[[layout_mat[3,1]]] +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect") &
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 8)
  )

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(results_dir, "inoculated_wald_GO_3x1_panel.png"),
  plot     = go_panel,
  width    = 6.5,
  height   = 9,
  units    = "in",
  dpi      = 600,
  bg       = "white"
)
```

```{r}
res_treatment  <- readRDS(file.path(objects_dir, "inoculated_wald_res_FEMvs201_24.rds"))

  dplyr::pull(UniProt_ID) |>

  dplyr::filter(!is.na(uniprot_id) & uniprot_id %in% u_with_targetGO) |>
  dplyr::select(

    uniprot_id, subject, pident, evalue, qstart, qend, sstart, send, description

print(genes)

write.csv(

)
```

### GO (up only)
```{r}
# Loop over contrasts
labels <- c("FEMvs201_24", "FEMvs201_48", "FEMvs201_72")
ont_list <- c("BP", "MF", "CC")

for (label in labels) {
  message("Processing UP only: ", label, " ...")

  # -----------------------------
  # Build background universe
  # -----------------------------

  res_obj <- readRDS(file.path(objects_dir, paste0("inoculated_wald_res_", label, ".rds")))

  tested_genes <- res_obj %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    tibble::rownames_to_column("gene") %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(pvalue)) %>%
    dplyr::pull(gene)

  tested_annotated <- tibble::tibble(gene = tested_genes) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(blast_top, by = "gene") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      uniprot_id = sub("sp\\|([^|]+)\\|.*", "\\1", subject)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      !is.na(subject),
      subject != "",
      !is.na(uniprot_id),
      uniprot_id != ""
    )

  gene_universe <- unique(tested_annotated$uniprot_id)

  gene2go_full <- goa %>%
    dplyr::filter(UniProt_ID %in% gene_universe) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(UniProt_ID) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(go_terms = list(unique(GO_ID)), .groups = "drop") %>%
    tibble::deframe()

  gene_universe <- intersect(gene_universe, names(gene2go_full))

  # -----------------------------
  # Load upregulated DEGs
  # -----------------------------

  in_file <- file.path(results_dir, paste0("inoculated_wald_DEGs_", label, "_annotated_L2FC1_up.csv"))

  if (!file.exists(in_file)) {
    message("  Missing file: ", in_file, " — skipping")
    next
  }

  deg_up <- read.csv(in_file, header = TRUE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

  deg_up <- deg_up %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      uniprot_id = sub("sp\\|([^|]+)\\|.*", "\\1", subject)
    )

  deg_uniprot <- unique(na.omit(deg_up$uniprot_id))
  deg_uniprot <- intersect(deg_uniprot, gene_universe)

  deg_goa <- goa %>%
    dplyr::filter(UniProt_ID %in% deg_uniprot)

  if (nrow(deg_goa) < 10) {
    message("  ", label, ": Too few upregulated DEGs with GO terms — skipping GO")
    next
  }

  # -----------------------------
  # Build topGO gene list
  # -----------------------------

  geneList <- factor(as.integer(gene_universe %in% deg_uniprot))
  names(geneList) <- gene_universe
  geneList <- factor(geneList, levels = c(0, 1))

  # -----------------------------
  # Run topGO
  # -----------------------------

  res_all <- list()

  for (ont in ont_list) {
    go_data <- new(
      "topGOdata",
      ontology = ont,
      allGenes = geneList,
      annot    = annFUN.gene2GO,
      gene2GO  = gene2go_full
    )

    result <- suppressMessages(capture.output(
      res <- runTest(go_data, algorithm = "weight01", statistic = "fisher"),
      file = NULL
    ))
    result <- res

    res_table <- GenTable(
      go_data,
      weight01  = result,
      ranksOf   = "weight01",
      useLevels = TRUE
    )

    res_table$Ontology <- ont
    res_all[[ont]] <- res_table
  }

  all_results <- dplyr::bind_rows(res_all)
  all_results$weight01 <- as.numeric(all_results$weight01)

  sig_results <- all_results %>%
    dplyr::filter(weight01 < 0.05)

  if (nrow(sig_results) == 0) {
    message("  ", label, ": No significant GO terms")
    next
  }

  write.csv(
    sig_results,
    file = file.path(results_dir, paste0("inoculated_wald_GO_terms_", label, "_enriched_up.csv")),
    row.names = FALSE
  )

  # -----------------------------
  # Add GO info back to up DEG table
  # -----------------------------

  all_go_by_uniprot <- deg_goa %>%
    dplyr::distinct(UniProt_ID, GO_ID) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(UniProt_ID) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      all_go_ids = paste(sort(unique(GO_ID)), collapse = ";"),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  sig_go <- sig_results %>%
    dplyr::transmute(
      GO_ID     = GO.ID,
      GO_Term   = Term,
      Ontology  = Ontology,
      go_p      = weight01,
      n_sig_deg = Significant
    )

  deg_enriched_go_long <- deg_goa %>%
    dplyr::distinct(UniProt_ID, GO_ID) %>%
    dplyr::inner_join(sig_go, by = "GO_ID")

  enriched_by_uniprot <- deg_enriched_go_long %>%
    dplyr::group_by(UniProt_ID) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      enriched_go_ids  = paste(sort(unique(GO_ID)), collapse = ";"),
      enriched_terms   = paste(sort(unique(GO_Term)), collapse = ";"),
      enriched_onts    = paste(sort(unique(Ontology)), collapse = ";"),
      n_enriched_terms = dplyr::n_distinct(GO_ID),
      best_go_p        = min(go_p, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  deg_with_go <- deg_up %>%
    dplyr::left_join(all_go_by_uniprot, by = c("uniprot_id" = "UniProt_ID")) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(enriched_by_uniprot, by = c("uniprot_id" = "UniProt_ID")) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      all_go_ids       = ifelse(is.na(all_go_ids), "", all_go_ids),
      enriched_go_ids  = ifelse(is.na(enriched_go_ids), "", enriched_go_ids),
      enriched_terms   = ifelse(is.na(enriched_terms), "", enriched_terms),
      enriched_onts    = ifelse(is.na(enriched_onts), "", enriched_onts),
      n_enriched_terms = ifelse(is.na(n_enriched_terms), 0, n_enriched_terms)
    )

  write.csv(
    deg_with_go,
    file = file.path(results_dir, paste0("inoculated_wald_GO_DEGs_", label, "_up_terms.csv")),
    row.names = FALSE,
    quote = TRUE
  )

  # -----------------------------
  # Plot
  # -----------------------------

  p <- ggplot2::ggplot(sig_results, ggplot2::aes(
    x     = Significant,
    y     = reorder(Term, -Significant),
    color = Ontology,
    size  = -log10(weight01)
  )) +
    ggplot2::geom_point() +
    ggplot2::scale_color_manual(values = c(BP = "#A6CEE3", MF = "#FDBF6F", CC = "#B2DF8A")) +
    ggplot2::labs(x = "Number of Genes", y = NULL) +
    cowplot::theme_cowplot() +
    ggplot2::theme(
      axis.text.x = ggplot2::element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1),
      plot.title  = ggplot2::element_text(size = 12)
    )

  ggplot2::ggsave(
    file.path(results_dir, paste0("inoculated_wald_GO_DEGs_", label, "_up.png")),
    plot   = p,
    width  = 10,
    height = 6,
    dpi    = 300,
    bg     = "white"
  )
}
```

```{r}
# Plot GO plots as panel for up only

# 1x3 layout order
layout_mat <- matrix(c("FEMvs201_24",
                       "FEMvs201_48",
                       "FEMvs201_72"),
                     nrow = 3, byrow = TRUE)
labels <- as.vector(layout_mat)

go_plot_list <- vector("list", length = length(labels))
names(go_plot_list) <- labels

make_blank <- function(title_txt, msg = "Too few upregulated DEGs\nwith GO terms") {
  ggplot() +
    annotate("text", x = 0, y = 0, label = msg) +
    labs(title = title_txt) +
    theme_void() +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 12, hjust = 0.5))
}

ont_list <- c("BP", "MF", "CC")

for (label in labels) {
  message("Processing UP panel: ", label, " ...")

  # Build background universe from DESeq2-tested genes
  res_obj <- readRDS(file.path(objects_dir, paste0("inoculated_wald_res_", label, ".rds")))

  tested_genes <- res_obj %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    tibble::rownames_to_column("gene") %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(pvalue)) %>%
    dplyr::pull(gene)

  tested_annotated <- tibble::tibble(gene = tested_genes) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(blast_top, by = "gene") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      uniprot_id = sub("sp\\|([^|]+)\\|.*", "\\1", subject)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      !is.na(subject),
      subject != "",
      !is.na(uniprot_id),
      uniprot_id != ""
    )

  gene_universe <- unique(tested_annotated$uniprot_id)

  gene2go_full <- goa %>%
    dplyr::filter(UniProt_ID %in% gene_universe) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(UniProt_ID) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(go_terms = list(unique(GO_ID)), .groups = "drop") %>%
    tibble::deframe()

  gene_universe <- intersect(gene_universe, names(gene2go_full))

  # Load upregulated DEGs
  in_file <- file.path(results_dir, paste0("inoculated_wald_DEGs_", label, "_annotated_L2FC1_up.csv"))

  if (!file.exists(in_file)) {
    go_plot_list[[label]] <- make_blank(label, "Missing upregulated DEG file")
    next
  }

  deg_annotated <- read.csv(in_file, header = TRUE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

  deg_annotated <- deg_annotated %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      uniprot_id = sub("sp\\|([^|]+)\\|.*", "\\1", subject)
    )

  deg_uniprot <- unique(na.omit(deg_annotated$uniprot_id))
  deg_uniprot <- intersect(deg_uniprot, gene_universe)

  deg_goa <- goa %>%
    dplyr::filter(UniProt_ID %in% deg_uniprot)

  if (nrow(deg_goa) < 10) {
    go_plot_list[[label]] <- make_blank(label)
    next
  }

  geneList <- factor(as.integer(gene_universe %in% deg_uniprot))
  names(geneList) <- gene_universe
  geneList <- factor(geneList, levels = c(0, 1))

  res_all <- list()

  for (ont in ont_list) {
    go_data <- new(
      "topGOdata",
      ontology = ont,
      allGenes = geneList,
      annot    = annFUN.gene2GO,
      gene2GO  = gene2go_full
    )

    result <- suppressMessages(capture.output(
      res <- runTest(go_data, algorithm = "weight01", statistic = "fisher"),
      file = NULL
    ))
    result <- res

    res_table <- GenTable(
      go_data,
      weight01  = result,
      ranksOf   = "weight01",
      useLevels = TRUE
    )

    res_table$Ontology <- ont
    res_all[[ont]] <- res_table
  }

  all_results <- dplyr::bind_rows(res_all)
  all_results$weight01 <- as.numeric(all_results$weight01)

  sig_results <- all_results %>%
    dplyr::filter(weight01 < 0.05) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(Ontology) %>%
    dplyr::slice_min(order_by = weight01, n = 8, with_ties = FALSE) %>% # show up to 8 terms per ontology (24 max)
    dplyr::ungroup()

  if (nrow(sig_results) == 0) {
    go_plot_list[[label]] <- make_blank(label, "No significant GO terms")
    next
  }

  idx <- which(layout_mat == label, arr.ind = TRUE)
  r <- idx[1]
  
  p <- ggplot(sig_results, aes(
    x     = Significant,
    y     = reorder(Term, -Significant),
    color = Ontology,
    size  = -log10(weight01)
  )) +
    geom_point() +
    scale_color_manual(values = c(BP = "#A6CEE3", MF = "#FDBF6F", CC = "#B2DF8A")) +
    guides(size = "none") +
    labs(
      title = label,
      x = if (r == 3) "Number of Genes" else NULL,
      y = "GO Term"
    ) +
    cowplot::theme_cowplot(font_size = 8) +
    theme(
      axis.text.x  = element_text(size = 8),
      axis.text.y  = element_text(size = 8),
      axis.title.x = element_text(size = 8),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 8),
      plot.title   = element_text(size = 9, hjust = 0.5),
      legend.position = "none",
      plot.margin = margin(4, 4, 4, 4)
    )

  go_plot_list[[label]] <- p
}

go_panel <-
  go_plot_list[[layout_mat[1,1]]] /
  go_plot_list[[layout_mat[2,1]]] /
  go_plot_list[[layout_mat[3,1]]] +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect") &
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 8)
  )

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(results_dir, "inoculated_wald_GO_3x1_panel_up.png"),
  plot     = go_panel,
  width    = 6.5,
  height   = 9,
  units    = "in",
  dpi      = 600,
  bg       = "white"
)
```

```{r}
# pull gene names from the relevant GO category
res_treatment  <- readRDS(file.path(objects_dir, "inoculated_wald_res_FEMvs201_72.rds"))
DEGs_treatment <- readRDS(file.path(objects_dir, "inoculated_wald_DEGs_FEMvs201_72.rds"))
target_go <- "GO:0098542"
go_tag <- paste(gsub(":", "", target_go), collapse = "_")
label <- "defense_response_72h_up"  

# if DEGs_treatment is now a single DESeqResults / data.frame (not a list):
deg <- DEGs_treatment |>
  as.data.frame() |>
  tibble::rownames_to_column("gene")

# Keep upregulated only
deg_up <- deg |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(log2FoldChange), log2FoldChange >= 1, !is.na(padj), padj < 0.05)

deg_annot <- deg_up |>
  dplyr::left_join(blast_top, by = "gene") |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    uniprot_id = sub("sp\\|([^|]+)\\|.*", "\\1", subject)
  )

# which UniProt IDs are annotated with the target GO
u_with_targetGO <- goa |>
  dplyr::filter(GO_ID %in% target_go) |>
  dplyr::pull(UniProt_ID) |>
  unique()

# keep only relevant genes whose UniProt has the target GO
genes <- deg_annot |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(uniprot_id) & uniprot_id %in% u_with_targetGO) |>
  dplyr::select(
    gene, log2FoldChange, padj,
    uniprot_id, subject, pident, evalue, qstart, qend, sstart, send, description
  ) |>
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(log2FoldChange))

print(genes)

# write to disk (label instead of tp_key)
write.csv(
  genes,
  file.path(results_dir, paste0("inoculated_wald_", go_tag, "_", label, "_L2FC1.csv")),
  row.names = FALSE
)
```

```{r}
model <- readRDS(file = file.path(objects_dir, "inoculated_wald_model.RData"))

vsd <- vst(dds, blind = FALSE)

expr_long <- vsd_mat %>%

# Join labels
```

### GO (down only)
```{r}
# Loop over contrasts
labels <- c("FEMvs201_24", "FEMvs201_48", "FEMvs201_72")
ont_list <- c("BP", "MF", "CC")

for (label in labels) {
  message("Processing down only: ", label, " ...")

  # -----------------------------
  # Build background universe
  # -----------------------------

  res_obj <- readRDS(file.path(objects_dir, paste0("inoculated_wald_res_", label, ".rds")))

  tested_genes <- res_obj %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    tibble::rownames_to_column("gene") %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(pvalue)) %>%
    dplyr::pull(gene)

  tested_annotated <- tibble::tibble(gene = tested_genes) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(blast_top, by = "gene") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      uniprot_id = sub("sp\\|([^|]+)\\|.*", "\\1", subject)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      !is.na(subject),
      subject != "",
      !is.na(uniprot_id),
      uniprot_id != ""
    )

  gene_universe <- unique(tested_annotated$uniprot_id)

  gene2go_full <- goa %>%
    dplyr::filter(UniProt_ID %in% gene_universe) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(UniProt_ID) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(go_terms = list(unique(GO_ID)), .groups = "drop") %>%
    tibble::deframe()

  gene_universe <- intersect(gene_universe, names(gene2go_full))

  # -----------------------------
  # Load downregulated DEGs
  # -----------------------------

  in_file <- file.path(results_dir, paste0("inoculated_wald_DEGs_", label, "_annotated_L2FC1_down.csv"))

  if (!file.exists(in_file)) {
    message("  Missing file: ", in_file, " — skipping")
    next
  }

  deg_down <- read.csv(in_file, header = TRUE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

  deg_down <- deg_down %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      uniprot_id = sub("sp\\|([^|]+)\\|.*", "\\1", subject)
    )

  deg_uniprot <- unique(na.omit(deg_down$uniprot_id))
  deg_uniprot <- intersect(deg_uniprot, gene_universe)

  deg_goa <- goa %>%
    dplyr::filter(UniProt_ID %in% deg_uniprot)

  if (nrow(deg_goa) < 10) {
    message("  ", label, ": Too few downregulated DEGs with GO terms — skipping GO")
    next
  }

  # -----------------------------
  # Build topGO gene list
  # -----------------------------

  geneList <- factor(as.integer(gene_universe %in% deg_uniprot))
  names(geneList) <- gene_universe
  geneList <- factor(geneList, levels = c(0, 1))

  # -----------------------------
  # Run topGO
  # -----------------------------

  res_all <- list()

  for (ont in ont_list) {
    go_data <- new(
      "topGOdata",
      ontology = ont,
      allGenes = geneList,
      annot    = annFUN.gene2GO,
      gene2GO  = gene2go_full
    )

    result <- suppressMessages(capture.output(
      res <- runTest(go_data, algorithm = "weight01", statistic = "fisher"),
      file = NULL
    ))
    result <- res

    res_table <- GenTable(
      go_data,
      weight01  = result,
      ranksOf   = "weight01",
      useLevels = TRUE
    )

    res_table$Ontology <- ont
    res_all[[ont]] <- res_table
  }

  all_results <- dplyr::bind_rows(res_all)
  all_results$weight01 <- as.numeric(all_results$weight01)

  sig_results <- all_results %>%
    dplyr::filter(weight01 < 0.05)

  if (nrow(sig_results) == 0) {
    message("  ", label, ": No significant GO terms")
    next
  }

  write.csv(
    sig_results,
    file = file.path(results_dir, paste0("inoculated_wald_GO_terms_", label, "_enriched_down.csv")),
    row.names = FALSE
  )

  # -----------------------------
  # Add GO info back to down DEG table
  # -----------------------------

  all_go_by_uniprot <- deg_goa %>%
    dplyr::distinct(UniProt_ID, GO_ID) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(UniProt_ID) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      all_go_ids = paste(sort(unique(GO_ID)), collapse = ";"),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  sig_go <- sig_results %>%
    dplyr::transmute(
      GO_ID     = GO.ID,
      GO_Term   = Term,
      Ontology  = Ontology,
      go_p      = weight01,
      n_sig_deg = Significant
    )

  deg_enriched_go_long <- deg_goa %>%
    dplyr::distinct(UniProt_ID, GO_ID) %>%
    dplyr::inner_join(sig_go, by = "GO_ID")

  enriched_by_uniprot <- deg_enriched_go_long %>%
    dplyr::group_by(UniProt_ID) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      enriched_go_ids  = paste(sort(unique(GO_ID)), collapse = ";"),
      enriched_terms   = paste(sort(unique(GO_Term)), collapse = ";"),
      enriched_onts    = paste(sort(unique(Ontology)), collapse = ";"),
      n_enriched_terms = dplyr::n_distinct(GO_ID),
      best_go_p        = min(go_p, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  deg_with_go <- deg_down %>%
    dplyr::left_join(all_go_by_uniprot, by = c("uniprot_id" = "UniProt_ID")) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(enriched_by_uniprot, by = c("uniprot_id" = "UniProt_ID")) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      all_go_ids       = ifelse(is.na(all_go_ids), "", all_go_ids),
      enriched_go_ids  = ifelse(is.na(enriched_go_ids), "", enriched_go_ids),
      enriched_terms   = ifelse(is.na(enriched_terms), "", enriched_terms),
      enriched_onts    = ifelse(is.na(enriched_onts), "", enriched_onts),
      n_enriched_terms = ifelse(is.na(n_enriched_terms), 0, n_enriched_terms)
    )

  write.csv(
    deg_with_go,
    file = file.path(results_dir, paste0("inoculated_wald_GO_DEGs_", label, "_down_terms.csv")),
    row.names = FALSE,
    quote = TRUE
  )

  # -----------------------------
  # Plot
  # -----------------------------

  p <- ggplot2::ggplot(sig_results, ggplot2::aes(
    x     = Significant,
    y     = reorder(Term, -Significant),
    color = Ontology,
    size  = -log10(weight01)
  )) +
    ggplot2::geom_point() +
    scale_color_manual(values = c(BP = "#A6CEE3", MF = "#FDBF6F", CC = "#B2DF8A")) +
    ggplot2::labs(x = "Number of Genes", y = NULL) +
    cowplot::theme_cowplot() +
    ggplot2::theme(
      axis.text.x = ggplot2::element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1),
      plot.title  = ggplot2::element_text(size = 12)
    )

  ggplot2::ggsave(
    file.path(results_dir, paste0("inoculated_wald_GO_DEGs_", label, "_down.png")),
    plot   = p,
    width  = 10,
    height = 6,
    dpi    = 300,
    bg     = "white"
  )
}
```

```{r}
  gene_universe <- intersect(gene_universe, names(gene2go_full))

  # Load downregulated DEGs
  in_file <- file.path(results_dir, paste0("inoculated_wald_DEGs_", label, "_annotated_L2FC1_down.csv"))

  if (!file.exists(in_file)) {
    go_plot_list[[label]] <- make_blank(label, "Missing downregulated DEG file")
    next
  }

  deg_annotated <- read.csv(in_file, header = TRUE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

  deg_annotated <- deg_annotated %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      uniprot_id = sub("sp\\|([^|]+)\\|.*", "\\1", subject)
    )

  deg_uniprot <- unique(na.omit(deg_annotated$uniprot_id))
  deg_uniprot <- intersect(deg_uniprot, gene_universe)

  deg_goa <- goa %>%
    dplyr::filter(UniProt_ID %in% deg_uniprot)

  if (nrow(deg_goa) < 10) {
    go_plot_list[[label]] <- make_blank(label)
    next
  }

  geneList <- factor(as.integer(gene_universe %in% deg_uniprot))
  names(geneList) <- gene_universe
  geneList <- factor(geneList, levels = c(0, 1))

  res_all <- list()

  for (ont in ont_list) {
    go_data <- new(
      "topGOdata",
      ontology = ont,
      allGenes = geneList,
      annot    = annFUN.gene2GO,
      gene2GO  = gene2go_full
    )

    result <- suppressMessages(capture.output(
      res <- runTest(go_data, algorithm = "weight01", statistic = "fisher"),
      file = NULL
    ))
    result <- res

    res_table <- GenTable(
      go_data,
      weight01  = result,
      ranksOf   = "weight01",
      useLevels = TRUE
    )

    res_table$Ontology <- ont
    res_all[[ont]] <- res_table
  }

  all_results <- dplyr::bind_rows(res_all)
  all_results$weight01 <- as.numeric(all_results$weight01)

  sig_results <- all_results %>%
    dplyr::filter(weight01 < 0.05) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(Ontology) %>%
    dplyr::slice_min(order_by = weight01, n = 8, with_ties = FALSE) %>% # show up to 8 terms per ontology (24 max)
    dplyr::ungroup()

  if (nrow(sig_results) == 0) {
    go_plot_list[[label]] <- make_blank(label, "No significant GO terms")
    next
  }

  idx <- which(layout_mat == label, arr.ind = TRUE)
  r <- idx[1]
  
  p <- ggplot(sig_results, aes(
    x     = Significant,
    y     = reorder(Term, -Significant),
    color = Ontology,
    size  = -log10(weight01)
  )) +
    geom_point() +
    scale_color_manual(values = c(BP = "#A6CEE3", MF = "#FDBF6F", CC = "#B2DF8A")) +
    guides(size = "none") +
    labs(
      title = label,
      x = if (r == 3) "Number of Genes" else NULL,
      y = "GO Term"
    ) +
    cowplot::theme_cowplot(font_size = 8) +
    theme(
      axis.text.x  = element_text(size = 8),
      axis.text.y  = element_text(size = 8),
      axis.title.x = element_text(size = 8),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 8),
      plot.title   = element_text(size = 9, hjust = 0.5),
      legend.position = "none",
      plot.margin = margin(4, 4, 4, 4)
    )

  go_plot_list[[label]] <- p
}

go_panel <-
  go_plot_list[[layout_mat[1,1]]] /
  go_plot_list[[layout_mat[2,1]]] /
  go_plot_list[[layout_mat[3,1]]] +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect") &
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 8)
  )

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(results_dir, "inoculated_wald_GO_3x1_panel_down.png"),
  plot     = go_panel,
  width    = 6.5,
  height   = 9,
  units    = "in",
  dpi      = 600,
  bg       = "white"
)


```
